source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5 with Fig. 9.16 and Examples 9.4 and 9.5 (PDF 202-204).

blocks.text: Figure 9.16 do mukhalif charged mutawazi plates dikhati hai jo yaksan electric field banati hain. Is field mein chalne diya gaya musbat charge q plate B se plate A ki taraf chalega aur kinetic energy hasil karega. Agar use A se B le jana ho to charge ko field ke khilaf chalane ke liye bairooni force chahiye, aur woh potential energy hasil karega. Shart rakhein ke charge ko A se B le jate hue electrostatic tawazun (equilibrium) mein rakha jaye, yaani woh yaksan velocity se chale; yeh raste ke har nuqte par qE ke barabar aur ulat force F laga kar hota hai. Field ke khilaf bairooni force ka kaam charge ki electrical potential energy barhata hai.

blocks.alt: Musbat charge +q oopar musbat aur neeche manfi plate ke darmiyan hai, jin ka fasla d hai. Field use qE force se neeche dhakelta hai; barabar force F = qE use field ke khilaf oopar le jati hai. Note kehta hai kaam qE d hai, is liye potential difference V = E d.
blocks.caption: Mukhalif charge wali plates ke darmiyan charge (Figure 9.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Maan lein W_AB woh kaam hai jo force musbat charge q ko tawazun mein rakhte hue A se B le jane mein karti hai. Us ki potential energy mein tabdeeli delta U = W_AB, ya U_B - U_A = W_AB ... (9.16), jahan U_A aur U_B nuqton A aur B par potential energies hain.

blocks.title: Electric potential difference
blocks.text: Electric field mein do nuqton A aur B ke darmiyan potential difference woh kaam hai jo unit musbat charge ko tawazun mein rakhte hue A se B le jane mein hota hai: delta V = V_B - V_A = W_AB/q = delta U/q ... (9.17), jahan V_A aur V_B nuqton A aur B par electric potentials hain.

Electric potential energy ka farq aur electric potential ka farq delta U = q delta V ... (9.18) se jure hain. Yun do nuqton ka potential difference fi unit charge potential energy ka farq bhi kaha ja sakta hai. Chunke potential energy ki unit joule hai, Eq. 9.17 dikhati hai ke potential difference ki unit joule per coulomb hai, jise volt kehte hain: 1 volt = 1 joule/1 coulomb ... (9.19). Yaani do nuqton ke darmiyan 1 volt ka potential difference tab hai jab 1 coulomb musbat charge ko tawazun mein rakhte hue ek nuqte se doosre tak le jane ka kaam ek joule ho.

Kisi nuqte par electric potential ka tasawwur dene ke liye ek hawala nuqta (reference) chahiye jise sifar potential diya jaye; ise aam taur par la-mehdood faasle (infinity) par lete hain. Yun Eq. 9.17 mein agar A infinity par ho aur V_A = 0 chunein to B par potential V_B = W_AB/q. Aam taur par V = W/q ... (9.20), jo kehta hai ke electric field ke kisi nuqte par electric potential us kaam ke barabar hai jo unit musbat charge ko tawazun mein rakhte hue infinity se us nuqte tak lane mein ho. Lihaza kisi nuqte ka potential hamesha infinity ke potential ke nisbat hai. Potential aur potential difference dono scalar hain, kyunke W aur q dono scalar hain.
Electric field potential gradient ke taur par

Phir Fig. 9.16 lein: plates ke darmiyan field yaksan hai, qeemat E. A aur B ka potential difference V_B - V_A = W_AB/q ... (9.21), jahan W_AB = Fd = -qEd (manfi alamat is liye ke charge ko tawazun mein rakhne ke liye F, qE ke ulat lagani parti hai). To V_B - V_A = -qEd/q = -Ed, ya E = -(V_B - V_A)/d = -delta V/d ... (9.22). Agar plates bohat hi chhote faasle delta d par hon to E = -delta V/delta d ... (9.23).

Miqdar delta V/delta d faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki zyada se zyada sharah (rate) deti hai, kyunke charge field line ke saath chalaya gaya, jis simt mein dono plates ka faasla delta d kam se kam hai; ise potential gradient kehte hain. Yun electric intensity potential ke gradient ke manfi ke barabar hai; manfi alamat batati hai ke E ki simt ghatte potential ki taraf hai. Eq. 9.23 se electric intensity ki unit volt per metre (V m^-1) hai, jo N C^-1 ke barabar hai: 1 V m^-1 = 1 (J C^-1) m^-1 = 1 N m/(m C) = 1 N C^-1.

blocks.title: Example 9.4
blocks.text: 1.0 cm door do mutawazi dhaati plates 12 V battery se jori hain. Un ke darmiyan electric field intensity nikalein. Hal: delta V = 12 V, delta d = 1.0 cm = 1 x 10^-2 m. E = delta V/delta d = 12 V/(1 x 10^-2 m) = 1200 V m^-1 (ya N C^-1).

blocks.title: Example 9.5
blocks.text: Do ufuqi mutawazi dhaati plates 12 V battery se jori hain. Manfi plate se ek electron chhora jata hai; musbat plate tak pohanchte waqt us ki speed nikalein (m = 9.1 x 10^-31 kg, e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C). Hal: electron manfi plate se dhakela aur musbat plate ki taraf khincha jata hai; khoi hui potential energy kinetic energy ban jati hai: delta V x e = (1/2) m v^2, 12 V x 1.6 x 10^-19 C = (1/2) x 9.1 x 10^-31 kg x v^2, to v^2 = 4.2 x 10^12 m^2 s^-2 aur v = 2.1 x 10^6 m s^-1.

ECG dil ke electrical amal se insani jild (skin) ke nuqton ke darmiyan bane 'voltage' record karti hai; daurte hue li gayi ECG dabao (stress) mein dil ki karkardagi batati hai. Electroencephalography mein dimagh ki electrical sargarmi se bane potential differences ghair-mamooli rawayye ki tashkhees (diagnosis) mein istemal hote hain (Do You Know).

blocks.prompt: Electric potential bayan kijiye aur sabit kijiye ke electric field intensity potential gradient ke manfi ke barabar hai (comprehensive question 9.1). 50 uC charge se 50 cm par potential nikalein (MCQ 9.5). Electric aalaat chalate hue rubber ke talwon wale joote kyun pehnne chahiyein (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: Kisi nuqte par potential musbat charge ko infinity se lane mein fi unit charge kaam hai, V = W/q; plates ke darmiyan W_AB = -qEd, to V_B - V_A = -Ed aur E = -delta V/delta d, potential gradient ka manfi. V = kq/r = 9 x 10^9 x 50 x 10^-6/0.5 = 9 x 10^5 V, option (c). Rubber insulator hai: yeh jism ko zameen tak raasta mukammal karne se rokta hai, to agar live taar chhu jaye to jism se bohat kam ya koi current nahi guzarta.

items: Charge q ko E ke khilaf A se B yaksan velocity se le jana: delta U = W_AB (9.16). Potential difference delta V = W_AB/q = delta U/q (9.17); delta U = q delta V (9.18); 1 V = 1 J C^-1 (9.19); potential V = W/q infinity se (9.20); scalars.
E = -delta V/delta d (9.23): field manfi potential gradient ke barabar, kam potential ki taraf; V m^-1 = N C^-1. Misalein: 1200 V m^-1; 2.1 x 10^6 m s^-1.
